# Daily Briefing — Friday 3 October

Yesterday was a mixed picture. No training session logged and 7,758 steps kept you lightly active, while your 2,382 kcal burn sat comfortably close to your 2,300 target — solid balance there. The honest flag though is that 4.3 hours of sleep. That's genuinely not enough, and your body will feel it.

The good news is your recovery markers are holding up surprisingly well. HRV at 108ms sits right in your 99–119ms baseline, and a 45bpm resting HR is excellent. Your stress at 32/100 is low. Your body is coping, but don't mistake resilience for a green light — go as planned today, but listen carefully during the effort.

Priority tonight: protect your sleep above everything. That 4.3 hours is your biggest risk to progress right now. Aim for 8 hours — it'll do more for your Chester prep than any extra session.
